consequences: No provider binding leaves jobs pending without attempts; shutdown drains before domain stores close; identity conflicts fail closed; lifecycle periodic scheduling and globally atomic cross-domain delivery remain separate work.
context: Default memory jobs were not scheduled and post-turn ingestion discarded conversation/turn/source identity, leaving crash-before-receipt replay gaps.
decision: Composition owns scheduler lifetime; committed-turn receipt and source materialization are atomic; Gate admission is resumable; renewable fenced job leases and validated-result checkpoints separate network work from SQLite writes.
title: Managed extraction and durable committed-turn identity
